input: i want more effort going into the ghp website. and the websites in general. better seo better marketing better view into whats being worked on recent developments updates and direction for the future. the development process etc. open book on the website. (follow-up) i also want a change log on the website.
task: Open-book Updates page and Changelog on the GitHub Pages site (owner request: SEO, marketing, what is being worked on, direction, process, changelog)

doc_friction.issue: Only dev/index.html was exempt from the dead-link check, though publish-branch.sh writes all of dev/ (stats.json, analyses/) after the check; a link to dev/analyses/ failed it.
Hand-kept list of top-level page buckets is not mentioned in platform/pages/README.md, so adding a site page fails gitops CI only after the push.

deviations.why: Session was started by a direct owner request, not 'follow prompt.md'; forced the ventures track for the record instead of the weighted draw (redteam).

notes: New platform/pages/updates.mjs writes updates/ (week in numbers, recently shipped, active research, in progress, owner direction from goals.md, process) and changelog/ (14 days of merges by area, filter, Atom feed). Nav item, hub sitemap, llms.txt, hub Built-in-public card. devstats publishes same-repo open PRs; publish checkout depth 400 -> 3000. Cut the changelog from 30 to 14 days after full history showed 3,025 merges / 834 KB.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a developer building two generated, tested site pages with feed, nav, sitemap and CI wiring in an unfamiliar 10k-line generator

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
